topic: Claude Code for non-coders: inherited a project folder? Ask Claude Code to explain it in plain English
post:
Someone handed you a project folder full of files you don't understand? 📁
Claude Code can explain it to you in plain English.

You don't have to change a thing. Just ask questions. Claude reads the files and answers. 🔍

Try it 👇
1️⃣ Open Claude Code in that folder
2️⃣ Start broad: "Give me an overview of this project"
3️⃣ Then narrow down to the part you care about
4️⃣ Ask for a glossary of the project's terms

Copy this prompt:
"Explain this project to me like I'm new to the team and don't code. What is it for, what are the main parts, and which files matter most? Give me a short glossary of any terms I'll hear. Don't change any files."

This comes straight from the Claude Code docs ✅
Their tips: start with broad questions, then narrow down, and request a glossary of project-specific terms.

📌 Claude Code is included with Claude's Pro and Max plans.

Why it matters:
You can join any project conversation with confidence, without waiting for someone to walk you through it. 💡

What folder would you ask Claude Code to explain first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
